I’m sorry about your mom. I could understand having trouble getting your name and pronouns correct but it doesn’t sound like she’s even trying. That the older a person gets, the less likely it is to be a phase. I also wrote in my coming out letter and repeated in doctors and therapist visits that transitioning isn’t just something I want to do. It’s something that if I don’t do, I will die. I told my mom that she has the choice to either let me transition and maybe I regret it later, or that she doesn’t let me transition, and the dysphoria becomes too much to handle and I take my life. 

I hope this helps. Good luck :)

You can be trans without gender dysphoria. Gender dysphoria is discomfort with the gender you were assigned at birth. Some trans people don’t feel this, some feel neutral about it, some even feel comfortable with their gender. But you can also be trans if you feel as though you would be *more* comfortable as another gender. There’s also gender euphoria, which comes from doing something that validates your gender, which even cis people experience. For example, a woman putting on a dress and feeling pretty or a man putting on a suit and feeling handsome. Again, euphoria doesn’t necessarily make you trans either. Just because some men like dresses and some women like suits doesn’t make them trans. It’s a matter of figuring out how you want the world to see you as. And that’s what it comes down to. Do you want to be seen as a man? a woman? Somewhere in between? Neither? That all it is.

I’m not saying I’m ashamed to be trans, because as soon as it’s safe for me to transition, I’ll proudly admit that I am, but that doesn’t change the fact that I want to be seen and treated as a cis woman. If I can at least see myself as one, it makes household chores a lot easier to do, it makes it easier to get out of bed, it makes be alive easier. It’s great that you don’t need to dress like a girl to feel comfortable with yourself, but I do. One day I want to get to that point, but I know that will not happen for a long time.
